title: emg2pose: Surface EMG and Hand Pose
description: This dataset is a NEMAR re-host and EMG-BIDS conversion of Meta's public emg2pose release, a large-scale benchmark pairing surface electromyography (sEMG) with hand pose estimation. It comprises 2 kHz, 16-channel wrist sEMG recordings synchronized with hand pose labels captured via a 26-camera motion-capture rig, spanning 193 users, 370 hours, and 29 behavioral stages with approximately 80 million labeled frames. The dataset supports research on EMG-based hand pose estimation and human-computer interaction.
methods_description: Surface EMG was recorded at 2 kHz across 16 channels from the wrist, paired with hand pose labels obtained from a 26-camera motion-capture rig. Upstream HDF5 recordings were converted to EMG-BIDS BDF files containing 16 EMG channels and 20 radian-valued joint-angle MISC channels, with BAD_IK annotations marking samples where inverse-kinematics labels are all zero.
